scope: Installed Linux x86-64 header qualification; not proof of the deployed target host or syscall availability.
interpretation: The captured ELF is machine62 and names glibc imports. Under this ordinary Linux x86-64 ABI, numeric424 identifies pidfd_send_signal, clock1 identifies CLOCK_MONOTONIC, error4 identifies EINTR and signal9 identifies SIGKILL. Flags0 is a relative sleep request; an interrupted call can return remaining time. None of these header facts establishes runtime behavior.
